capabilities: Search notes and saved memories from a panel
Save selected note text as a memory with its note path
List memories related to the open note
Show ModelBrain connection status and version in settings
disambiguation: Not an AI chat plugin; it only searches and saves memories through the separate ModelBrain app and writes no answers itself.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux). The plugin runs two helper programs installed by the ModelBrain app and makes no network requests. The plugin is MIT-licensed open source, but the ModelBrain app itself is closed source. Free without an account; paid plans only cover sync and team sharing the plugin does not use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for outside AI assistants to search a vault or remember facts the user has told them across sessions.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a window onto the ModelBrain desktop app. It does nothing without it.
save a selection as a memory that Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor can all recall

requires.name: ModelBrain paid sync and team sharing

summary: Window onto the free ModelBrain desktop app that lets Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor search this vault and recall saved memories, indexed locally.
